doc_meta_desc: Official developer documentation for Povixa Platform: unified SDK, 9 native subsystems, zero-trust security and self-hosting guides.
doc_hero_desc: A single client SDK, 9 native subsystems, zero duct tape SaaS. Run on cloud or self-host 100% on your own metal.
card_quickstart_desc: Integrate 1 unified SDK replacing 9 disparate tools. Configure environment variables and run.
card_docker_desc: Run the entire stack (Core, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse & MinIO) with a single docker-compose.yml file.
card_sdks_desc: First-class type-safe client libraries for TypeScript, Go, Python, Flutter/Dart and Rust.
card_security_desc: Distributed token verification via ed25519 signatures, WebAuthn Passkeys and RBAC.
sec_1_desc: Select your preferred package manager to install the official typed client.
sec_1_tip: Design note: You only need to import @povixa/sdk to interact with all 9 subsystems (Auth, Config, S3, Notify, Telemetry, etc.). No fragmented dependencies.
sec_2_desc: Real-world code specification with complete end-to-end type safety for each language.
sec_3_desc: Click any subsystem to preview live JSON response payload and edge response latency.
sec_4_desc: Full data sovereignty. Run on personal VPS, Hetzner, AWS, or on-premise bare-metal cluster.
sec_5_desc: How a single Client SDK communicates through Edge Gateway to decoupled subsystems.
layer_2_desc: ed25519 Token Verification, In-Memory Flag Caching (<2ms), Presign S3 URL Dispatcher.
feedback_desc: Share your feedback to help us refine the technical documentation.
feedback_thanks: Thank you for your feedback! It will be reviewed for upcoming releases.

cta_ready_title: Ready to build with a unified platform?
cta_ready_desc: Free forever for community and open source projects with Povixa badge. Zero credit card required.
